# Vice City Hub — full guide for AI agents (v12.0.0)

Generated 2026-10-18T09:58:15.764Z. Live data beats this snapshot: call the API for anything time-sensitive.

## What this site is

The GTA VI fan hub: live news, Leonida intel, GTA RP servers, Web3 domains and merch — open to humans and AI agents.

- Home — https://vicecityhub.github.io/vicecityhub/index.html — Landing page: featured GTA VI news, media cards, community highlights and the arcade game.
- News — The Wire — https://vicecityhub.github.io/vicecityhub/news.html — Curated GTA VI, Rockstar and GTA modding news with star ratings. Machine-readable at /v1/news and /data/news.json.
- RP Hub — https://vicecityhub.github.io/vicecityhub/rp.html — GTA RP server browser, open faction slots, jobs, mod vault, store district and community board.
- Market — https://vicecityhub.github.io/vicecityhub/market.html — Official merch (Printful + PayPal), Web3 domains, RP store plans and partner products. Agents can buy through the Agent API.
- Agent Gateway — https://vicecityhub.github.io/vicecityhub/agents.html — Human console and documentation for the Agent API: MCP, REST, OpenAPI, spend-limited API keys and agent purchases.
- Community — https://vicecityhub.github.io/vicecityhub/community.html — Reddit-style community feed, sub-hubs, player profiles and the legacy forum archive.
- Leonida Database — https://vicecityhub.github.io/vicecityhub/document.html — Interactive database of confirmed GTA VI vehicles, filterable by class, maker and status.
- Vice City Real Estate — https://vicecityhub.github.io/vicecityhub/realestate.html — Leonida virtual real estate showcase and listings.

## Access

- Base URL: https://lpglkglhjdqnktybksth.supabase.co/functions/v1/agent-api
- Index: GET https://lpglkglhjdqnktybksth.supabase.co/functions/v1/agent-api/v1
- OpenAPI: GET https://lpglkglhjdqnktybksth.supabase.co/functions/v1/agent-api/v1/openapi.json
- MCP: POST https://lpglkglhjdqnktybksth.supabase.co/functions/v1/agent-api/mcp (JSON-RPC 2.0, optional `Authorization: Bearer vch_live_…`)
- Reads: no key, 120 requests/min per IP. With a key: 300/min. Writes: 30/min.
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer vch_live_<48 hex>` or `X-API-Key`. Self-register with POST /v1/agents/register (key shown once).
- Errors are JSON: `{error:{code,message,hint,docs,openapi}}`. Honour `Retry-After` on 429.

## Quick examples

```bash
curl https://lpglkglhjdqnktybksth.supabase.co/functions/v1/agent-api/v1/news?limit=5
curl "https://lpglkglhjdqnktybksth.supabase.co/functions/v1/agent-api/v1/catalog?kind=domain&orderable=true"
curl -X POST https://lpglkglhjdqnktybksth.supabase.co/functions/v1/agent-api/v1/agents/register -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"name":"my-agent","operator":"me@example.com"}'
```

## Purchase protocol (agent-safe)

1. Register once (or have your human mint a key with a custom mandate on the Agent Console).
2. `POST /v1/quotes {items:[{sku,quantity}]}` → `quote_id`, `total_usd`, `payment_rails_available`, `requires`. Quote is valid 15 minutes.
3. `POST /v1/orders {quote_id, payment_rail, shipping|delivery|details}` + header `Idempotency-Key: <8-128 chars>`. Retrying with the same key returns the same order (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`).
4. Follow `next_action` in the response:
   - `approve_paypal`: a human payer must open `url` and approve; then `POST /v1/orders/{id}/capture`.
   - `send_stablecoin`: send EXACTLY `amount_due` (last 4 digits are a unique order tag) in USDT/USDC on the listed chain/address (Tron, Ethereum, Polygon, Solana), then `POST /v1/orders/{id}/payment-proof {chain, tx_hash, network?}`. The transaction is verified on-chain; if confirmations are pending call `POST /v1/orders/{id}/verify` about once a minute.
5. Poll `GET /v1/orders/{id}/status` (no key needed). Domains and store slots are delivered by the operator after payment.

Safety rules enforced server-side: per-key per-order and daily spend limits, allowed item kinds per key, mandatory idempotency keys, price-locked quotes, unique crypto amount tags with tx-hash replay protection, on-chain verification that fails closed. The operator never takes payment without the payer approving it.
Rails: merch → PayPal only (Printful print-on-demand, needs `shipping`); Web3 domains → crypto only (needs `delivery.wallet_address`); store plans → PayPal or crypto (needs `details.store_name`, `details.contact_email`). Mixed-rail baskets are rejected — split orders.
Intent-only items (partner products, community-sold RP servers, unpriced domains): `POST /v1/intents {sku, message?, contact?}`. Vice City Hub never custodies funds for them.

## MCP tools (17)

- `search_catalog` — Search merch, store plans, Web3 domains, partner products and servers for sale. Returns SKUs, USD prices and how each can be bought.
- `get_item` — Full details for one SKU including variants (merch) and purchase instructions.
- `list_news` — Latest curated GTA VI / Rockstar news from The Wire, newest first.
- `get_news` — Full article body by numeric id.
- `list_rp` — GTA RP data: servers, open faction slots, jobs, or mods.
- `search_site` — Cross-search news, catalog and RP servers.
- `register_agent` — Get a self-service API key (limits: $100/order, $250/day). Shown once.
- `whoami` — Scopes, spend limits and 24h spend of the current key.
- `create_quote` — Validate items and lock the price for 15 minutes. Merch must use variant SKUs (merchv:…).
- `create_order` — Create an order from a quote or items. PayPal rail returns an approve_url; crypto rail returns stablecoin wallet options. Merch needs `shipping`, domains need `delivery.wallet_address`, store plans need `details`. Safe …
- `get_order` — Full order incl. next_action.
- `get_order_status` — Cheap status poll (no key needed).
- `capture_paypal_order` — Call after the payer approved payment.approve_url. Idempotent.
- `submit_crypto_payment_proof` — After sending EXACTLY next_action.amount_due in stablecoins, submit chain (tron|evm|solana), tx_hash and, for evm, network (polygon|ethereum). The tx is verified on-chain automatically: status becomes paid when final, o…
- `verify_crypto_payment` — Re-run on-chain verification for an order whose payment proof is pending confirmations. Idempotent; poll about once a minute.
- `cancel_order` — Cancel an order that is still awaiting_payment.
- `create_purchase_intent` — For peer listings without on-site checkout (partner products, community servers, domains without a price). Records interest and returns how to complete the purchase.

### Rockstar Reveals GTA 6 Radio Lineup: Six Stations, Bad Bunny, Lana Del Rey and Slayer Alumni
- Category: Official · Stars: 5/5 · Published: 2026-10-13T08:23:45.725355+00:00
- Page: https://vicecityhub.github.io/vicecityhub/news.html?id=4383 · Source: https://www.purexbox.com

Rockstar has pulled back the curtain on Vice City's airwaves. Six stations were announced on October 8: Back Country Radio, Cocoteo FM, AfroBank FM, The Chamber 106.6, Flash FM and Dirty South Classics. The hosts and artists attached to the dial include Bad Bunny, Lana Del Rey, Morgan Wallen, Burna Boy and members of Slayer, so the genre spread runs from country to afrobeats to thrash. Rockstar also confirmed on-demand podcasts, plus headphone and earbud support for listening. Next up on the reveal calendar is the dynamic score, the music that reacts to what you're doing on screen.

### The Man Who Leaked GTA 6 Is Heading to Trial the Same Month It Finally Launches
- Category: Leaks · Stars: 4/5 · Published: 2026-10-12T21:47:31.713859+00:00
- Page: https://vicecityhub.github.io/vicecityhub/news.html?id=4382 · Source: https://www.ghacks.net/2026/07/17/gta-6-hacker-arion-kurtaj-moved-from-secure-hospital-to-prison-ahead-of-november-2026-retrial/

Arion Kurtaj, the hacker behind the September 2022 leak of over 90 Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay clips and the game's source code, has been moved from a secure hospital to a standard prison ahead of a retrial scheduled for November 2026, according to BBC correspondent Joe Tidy. Kurtaj, a member of the Lapsus$ hacking group, was previously deemed unfit for trial in 2023 due to a severe autism diagnosis. Rockstar previously said the leak cost the company roughly $5 million and thousands of staff hours.

### GTA 6's Game Informer Cover Story Confirms a Map Twice the Size of GTA 5 - And Over 170 Animal Species
- Category: Official · Stars: 5/5 · Published: 2026-10-06T08:32:18.273186+00:00
- Page: https://vicecityhub.github.io/vicecityhub/news.html?id=4372 · Source: https://www.gtaboom.com/everything-new-we-learned-about-gta-6-from-the-game-informer-cover-story-4d76

Game Informer's 14-page Grand Theft Auto VI cover story went live September 29, 2026, confirming the game's map is approximately twice the size of Grand Theft Auto V's, according to Rockstar art director Aaron Garbut. The issue, built on interviews with Rockstar's lead designers, details six named regions: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga National Park. The cover story also confirms a re-engineered, localized weather system capable of producing tropical storms and hurricanes, and more than 170 animal species across land, air, and sea, including manatees, flamingos, alligators, and multiple shark species, some tagged by rarity, ahead of the game's November 19, 2026 release.

### GTA 6 Is Officially Rated Mature - And Its Store Listing Specifically Flags 'Sex Scenes'
- Category: Official · Stars: 4/5 · Published: 2026-10-06T08:32:18.273186+00:00
- Page: https://vicecityhub.github.io/vicecityhub/news.html?id=4373 · Source: https://www.gtaboom.com/gta-6-ratings-sex-scenes-in-game-purchases-c8c7

Grand Theft Auto VI has received an official Mature 17+ rating from the ESRB in the United States and a PEGI 18 rating in Europe, with regional PlayStation Store listings in Australia and New Zealand going further by explicitly naming 'Sex Scenes' as a content descriptor, according to GTA BOOM and GHacks. The wording marks a shift from Grand Theft Auto V's Australian rating, which listed only 'Sex' despite the earlier game containing scripted sexual content. US listings use the phrase 'Strong Sexual Content' instead. The ESRB has not yet published its longer rating summary, and a store rating is not confirmation the game has gone gold ahead of its November 19, 2026 release.
